entities.title: On a pull request
entities.summary: Shatterbelt is typechecked, tested and built, and every .dev diagram and knowledge file is validated.
entities.trigger: A pull request that changes games/shatterbelt outside its .dev folders, or anything under .github/ outside .github/.dev (ci.yml).
checks: npm test: tsc --noEmit, then the node:test suites in test/
No .dev folders in dist/: the build must not ship the folders' documentation
python3 Meta/Agents/Skills/validate_diagrams.py, for the whole repository
The Database migration check, when worker/schema.sql or worker/migrations/ change
notChecked: Behavior in a real browser: the page, input, drawing and sound.
The games hub's relay and lobby, and the sign-in routes on icelander.net.

entities.title: On a push to main
entities.summary: The same steps again, then wrangler deploy.
entities.trigger: A push to main that changes games/shatterbelt or .github/, or Run workflow on the Deploy workflow (shatterbelt or all).
checks: The migration gate: every database change since the last deploy has been acknowledged
No .dev folders in dist/: the build must not ship the folders' documentation
